clips.title: The story
paras: At Northshire Abbey, Brother Neals keeps watch over the food and drink stores. He oversees shipments and samples wine from the local vineyard.

Brother Neals keeps Northshire Abbey supplied with food and drink from his rooms in the upper belfry. He follows the grape manifests from the Northshire vineyards and tastes the wine to check its quality. He also watches the shipments arriving from the fields around the valley.
